metadata.description: Claude Code plugins by Jonah Schulte

plugins.name: editor-rescue
plugins.description: Rescue hundreds of hoarded unsaved Sublime Text / VS Code / Cursor buffers into organized notes, flag pasted credentials, and reset the editors so they open empty again.

plugins.name: codebase-audit
plugins.description: Evidence-first reviews of a whole codebase: a scored health audit with seven specialist lenses and a sweep that runs them together, an exhaustive check for violations of the codebase's own conventions, and a finish-line roadmap for what done should mean.

plugins.name: pr-workflow
plugins.description: Five skills for the life of a pull request: deliver a change end to end without supervision, turn a draft into something reviewable, resolve review feedback, get a release verdict before merging, and burn down a backlog of issues into batched PRs.
